verdict.rationale: PagerDuty publishes its public APIs as OpenAPI definitions in the official PagerDuty/api-schema GitHub repo. The developer docs give a direct raw URL to the REST API's openapiv3.json for import into tools like Postman. The developer.pagerduty.com API reference is OpenAPI-based and covers the REST, Events, SCIM, MCP and integration APIs. The probe's 404s at guessed support.pagerduty.com paths don't contradict this, because the spec is hosted elsewhere. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec downloads and parses correctly, and no discovery at a standard well-known path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Use [this URL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PagerDuty/api-schema/main/reference/REST/openapiv3.json) in the OpenAPI import tool to integrate Postman with OpenAPI
This repository contains our OpenAPI defined public APIs.
Interactive OpenAPI reference for the PagerDuty REST API, Events API, SCIM, MCP server, and integration APIs.
